document_status: publisher-maintained; not an MCP discovery standard
name: Translator by Stage5

recommended_entrypoints.intent: translate subtitles or understand the translation workflow
edit, time, style, review, or export an SRT subtitle file
create translated speech or dub a video
compare free tools, Stage5 credits, and bring-your-own providers
check formats, platforms, connectivity, exports, or product boundaries

windows_install.safety: Cancel installation if Windows shows a different publisher.

setup: Install Translator and keep it open while the agent works
Settings → Agent Control → Allow agent control (takes effect immediately) and allow a folder for saved files
Claude Code: claude mcp add translator -- /Applications/Translator.app/Contents/Resources/translator-mcp
Claude Desktop: add {"mcpServers":{"translator":{"command":"/Applications/Translator.app/Contents/Resources/translator-mcp"}}} to claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude
Windows: use the launcher path shown in Settings → Agent Control (ends in resources\translator-mcp.cmd)
capability_groups: ranked video search, pagination, and bounded batch download
Downloads library search, open, and re-download
original, translation, or dual subtitle display
Default, Classic, Boxed, and LineBox subtitle styles
context-preserving SRT translation, review, editing, and export
caption track discovery and import (creator, auto and YouTube-translated)
safety_boundaries: Agent Control is off by default. The user turns it on in Settings.
The agent writes only to folders the user allows. File-writing and network actions should remain subject to the MCP host's normal approval controls.
The agent never sees stored API keys, cannot change app settings and cannot open checkout or buy anything.
Translating with the agent is free; paid steps run only when the agent explicitly requests them.

free_workflow.summary: Subtitle a video with the user's own Claude or Codex subscription and no Stage5 credits when the video has captions.
steps: plan_job (transcription_method creator_captions or youtube_auto_captions, translation_provider agent)
free_workflow.paid_steps: Audio transcription for videos without captions, dubbing and the legacy app_start_* inference tools spend Stage5 credits or the user's own API key, only when requested.
